details: Iran has reported no progress in ongoing talks with the United States regarding an interim peace deal. This diplomatic deadlock signals a continued stalemate in efforts to ease tensions between the two nations, raising geopolitical and energy-market risks. This could lead to increased volatility in the crypto market and potentially spur crypto adoption in Iran amidst ongoing sanctions.
title: Iran Says No Progress in Interim Peace Deal with US

details: European shares edged higher as falling oil prices shifted investor focus towards weakening demand, amidst stalled US-Iran peace efforts and persistent disruption in the Strait of Hormuz. However, Swissquote, a financial and trading services provider, saw its shares tumble by 10.7% after missing first-half expectations due to weak cryptocurrency income.
title: European Shares Up, Swissquote Reports Weak Crypto Income

details: Panama Canal fees have significantly increased, with one ship reportedly paying $4 million to "jump the queue." This surge is attributed to the ongoing "Iran war" and the El Niño weather phenomenon, which has led to falling water levels expected to limit the number of slots for transit through the crucial shipping lane.
title: Panama Canal Fees Soar Due to Iran War and El Niño

details: Wall Street saw a relief rally as investors processed cooler-than-expected inflation data and positive corporate earnings from AI infrastructure firms. The September CPI printed at 3.0% year-over-year, below the 3.1% forecast, reinforcing expectations that the Federal Reserve will hold interest rates steady. This resilience in the S&P 500, despite trade tensions and geopolitical risks, highlights the market's focus on corporate fundamentals and Fed policy. Gold continues to find support from central bank demand and geopolitical hedging.
title: US Inflation Cools, S&P 500 Rallies on AI and Fed Expectations
